Spatial Real Estate Analytics

Virginia Residential Valuation & Deal Screener

This interactive tool evaluates 23,435 single-family listings across Virginia using a LightGBM spatial pricing model (R² = 0.85) to pinpoint properties trading below their local submarket fair value.

  • Blue/Teal Hubs: Zip-code benchmarks sized by inventory and colored by median $/sq ft.
  • Green Pins: Top potential value-add deals (≥ 20% below modeled value).
  • Layer Menu (Top Right): Toggle overpriced listings (≥ 25% above model) or switch views.
Created by Courtney Hodge
